elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(i) expressly warrants that the Services, including Hosting Services and Support Services, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.

elements.element: Services conform to their documentation for 90 days following performance.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(ii) warrants for 90 days following performance that the Services will conform to their documentation.

elements.element: Deliverables conform to their documentation for 90 days following performance of the Services.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(ii) applies the 90-day conformance warranty to “any deliverables,” measured from performance of the Services.

elements.element: The Interface and all related software conform to their documentation for 12 months following delivery.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(iii) provides a 12-month documentation-conformance warranty following delivery for the Interface and all related software.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes repair, although the remedy is selected at TrueLink’s option.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes replacement, although the remedy is selected at TrueLink’s option.

elements.element: Refund of fees paid for the nonconforming item is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly permits a refund of fees paid for the nonconforming Services, deliverables, Interface, or software, although selected at TrueLink’s option.

elements.element: TrueLink complies with all laws applicable to its performance under the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(iv) expressly warrants compliance with all laws applicable to TrueLink’s performance under the Agreement.

elements.element: The Interface and all related software contain no malicious code when provided to Client.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(v) warrants that, when provided to Client, the Interface and related software will be free from viruses, worms, Trojan horses, and any other malicious code.

elements.element: Services are performed in a professional and workmanlike manner.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(i) expressly provides the required performance standard.

elements.element: Services conform to their documentation for at least 30 days following performance.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides a 90-day Services conformance period, exceeding the 30-day fallback period.

elements.element: Deliverables conform to their documentation for at least 30 days following performance of the Services.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides a 90-day deliverables conformance period, exceeding the 30-day fallback period.

elements.element: The Interface and all related software conform to their documentation for at least 90 days following delivery.
elements.evidence: The rendered clause provides a 12-month software conformance period, exceeding the 90-day fallback period.

elements.element: Repair is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes repair, subject to TrueLink’s selection.

elements.element: Replacement is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes replacement, subject to TrueLink’s selection.

elements.element: Refund of fees paid for the nonconforming item is available as a remedy for breach of the performance warranties.
elements.evidence: The remedy sentence expressly includes a refund of fees paid for the applicable nonconforming item, subject to TrueLink’s selection.

elements.element: TrueLink complies with all laws applicable to its performance under the Agreement.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(iv) expressly provides the applicable-laws warranty.

elements.element: The Interface and all related software contain no malicious code when provided to Client.
elements.evidence: Section 9(a)(v) expressly provides the malicious-code warranty.

result.reason: The operative language contains every preferred warranty, duration, and remedy and therefore also exceeds the fallback durations. However, the remedy sentence adds unrequested TrueLink discretion over remedy selection and refers broadly to a breach of “this Section.” That phrase may encompass all of Section 9, not merely the new performance warranties, potentially allowing replacement or refund instead of the preexisting mandatory Y2K repairs and upgrades. This unnecessary scope ambiguity prevents the redline from being minimal and may alter or contradict the existing Y2K remedial arrangement.
